title: Terminal manual
axis: mono-led: rail and contents in JetBrains Mono 13 with tree glyphs; Inter 16 tight column; code blocks dominate with a hanging line gutter and copy control; headings hang a mono anchor hash; the active path in the orange spark
worse_at: mono navigation is about 20% wider and slower to scan, so long titles truncate and the 32-entry rail runs past the fold; long commands scroll sideways inside their blocks, mostly off-screen on the phone; the spark colour is also the WITNESS/REFUSE colour
